existing_original_JSON_fails_closed.outcome: ValueError before recovery classification; existing artifact preserved

valid_local_precedes_manifest_admission.outcome: REUSED_COMPLETE before manifest receipt admission; no new worker requested

boundary_semantics: Opt-in manifest admits only listed identities with an unchanged SHA256-pinned original receipt, matching identity, status COMPLETE, exitcode equal to zero, result_valid exactly true, and both original JSON and sibling NPZ absent.
For the actual394 original receipts, exitcode is additionally independently verified as integer0. No failure receipt was relabeled as success.

Recovery modifies the receipt filename only: rei_<identity>.recovery_<safe_recovery_id>.receipt.json. CPU leases and rei_job_<identity>.lock remain in /tmp/cosmosapjw_hpc64_cpu_leases. The second classifier under the case lock remains active.
Atomic STARTED/final records are written to the separate recovery registry; all394 original global receipts and preserved copies remain byte-identical to the manifest hashes.

Valid local completed_result is intentionally reused before missing-artifact admission checks. This permits replay after recovery has restored files and starts no worker; invalid local data receives no such bypass.

Failed, started, unknown, or corrupt recovery receipts are preserved; a local attempt marker blocks replacement. The existing non-overwrite attempt and scientific NPZ/receipt writers remain unchanged.

If JSON or NPZ at the original result path has reappeared but is not valid local reusable output, recovery_registry raises ValueError before classifier status generation. This is a hard fail-closed return, not automatic partial recovery, and existing bytes are retained.

Original and recovery receipt fields are trusted local evidence, not a general adversarial manifest format. This review is scoped to the actual missing-artifact recovery and its failure-preservation boundary.
limitations: No concurrent stress test or IVP was performed; unchanged case/CPU lock code and actual completed receipts were inspected.
No additional feature work or scientific-source edit was made by this review.

Failure/partial-attempt preservation is scoped to the selected recovery_id and existing output attempt markers. A deliberately different recovery_id together with a fresh output directory selects another receipt/attempt namespace; this change is not certified as a global retry-prevention policy across arbitrary new manifests.
